That happens behind the FREDDY / OR PINHEAD? title in the last ~0.3 s (400.2 s grey frame, 400.4-400.5 s blue end-card bar). The mask also leaves the frame at about 399.3 s, so the last second is only blurry passengers.
issues.fix_note: Keep in-point 167.0, where the mask close-up starts. The index says content ends at 172.85, but the real content end is about 172.7, after which come black and the blue end card. Add speed 0.8 ([8.5,'s6_subway',167,0.8]) so the ~5 s tail only uses about 4 s of source and stays on the mask through the end. Another option is to cut the s18 pad from 1.5 to about 1.1 s. Do not move the in-point earlier: 163-167 is a woman being gagged, with no mask.

validation.reason: I'm accepting [8.5,'s6_subway',167,0.8]. In the render the shot starts at about 395.6 s and runs to the end at 400.5 s, so it lasts about 4.9 s. At speed 0.8 that uses about 3.9 s of source, from 167.0 to about 170.9. I checked 167.0-171.0 at 10 fps (contact sheet a.jpg). The hooded Ghostface mask is clearly visible and centred in every frame from 167.0 to 170.9: there are no cuts, no black frames and no other people taking over the shot. Around 168.6-169.5 the head turns a little and slightly blurs, but the mask stays easy to see. In the source (b.jpg), the mask stays in frame until about 171.7. After that come blurry passengers (171.8-172.7), a grey/black frame at about 172.8, and the blue end card at about 172.9. So even with a few frames of rounding, the slowed shot finishes about 0.8 s before the mask leaves the frame and about 1.9 s before the black frame and end card. The in-point is correct as it is. A slightly earlier one is not needed, and 163-167 shows no mask. The FREDDY / OR PINHEAD? title sits over the mask's upper half (see the current render, c.jpg) but leaves the eyes and mouth visible. That is unchanged by this fix, so I didn't count it against the proposal.
